verdict.rationale: PostHog documents its own export paths. Batch exports schedule data exports to supported destinations, and the query docs point bulk or recurring exports to batch exports or file download exports. Realtime CDP destinations, including a generic webhook, can stream events out. The MIT-licensed self-host deployment also reduces lock-in. The evidence never names the open formats used (e.g. CSV/Parquet), never lists the supported destinations, and never shows that everything (persons, replays, flags, dashboards) can be exported. missing for 10: explicit open export formats, a documented full-account export covering all data types, the list of batch export destinations, independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete migration away.
